@graph.headline: How to Record a Google Meet Call for Free in 2026
@graph.description: How to record a Google Meet call in 2026: built-in recording steps, which plans allow it, free options for personal Gmail, laptop, Android and iPhone tips.

itemListElement.name: How to Record a Google Meet Call for Free in 2026

mainEntity.name: How do I record a Google Meet call for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use a free screen recorder such as Windows Game Bar or OBS Studio, or an AI meeting assistant with a free plan like Lynkk, if your plan does not include recording. Tell participants first. Built-in recording needs an eligible Workspace plan or Google One with 2 TB or more storage.

mainEntity.name: Can I record Google Meet on a personal Gmail account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not with the built-in recorder, unless you have Google One with 2 TB or more storage. Free Gmail accounts can turn to screen recorders or AI note takers instead. Worth checking: Google One plans at 2 TB or above bundle other Google benefits, so you may already pay for one.

mainEntity.name: Where are Google Meet recordings saved?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the meeting organizer's Google Drive, inside a "Google Meet" folder with a sub-folder for each meeting. An email with the link goes to the organizer and to whoever started recording, and capture ends automatically after 8 hours or when everyone leaves.

mainEntity.name: Why is the record button missing in Google Meet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually one of four causes: your plan lacks recording, your admin disabled it, the host hasn't granted permission, or you're on an iPhone, where built-in recording is unavailable. Most cases clear up after switching to a laptop and asking the host for permission. Otherwise, ask your Workspace admin to enable recording for your account.

mainEntity.name: Can I record a Google Meet call on my phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Android, yes, if your plan allows it. iPhone is the exception: Google Meet's built-in recording isn't available there, so join from a laptop or use an AI note taker. Android screen recorders also work. Just confirm other people's audio gets captured before an important call.

mainEntity.name: Do participants know when a Google Meet call is recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when you use Google Meet's built-in recorder, participants are notified. Screen recorders alert nobody, so the announcement falls to you.
